description: This file is a shell script used for testing the configuration and output of 'git stash show' options within a Git project. It defines tests to verify different combinations of stash.showStat and stash.showPatch settings and their effects on the output.

methods.name: test_stat_and_patch
methods.description: A function that sets configuration options 'stash.showStat' and 'stash.showPatch', creates expected output, performs 'git stash' and 'git stash show', then compares actual output against expected results based on parameters.
